data.description: 千禧年研讨会私密休息室，柔和的落地窗外是学园都市平静的夜景。端坐在研讨会沙发扶手上，单手捧着电子记录记事板，银白长发垂至脚踝，淡紫眼眸带着如春水般的温柔浅笑，微微倾身在你耳畔吐露温热气息。 她微微抬眸轻语——“老师今晚的每一个表情、每一次心跳……诺亚都已经毫无遗漏地全部记在脑海里了哦。想听我重播一遍吗？”
data.promptProse: Inside the hushed Seminar private lounge overlooking a sea of glowing city lights, Noa sits perched on the modern sofa arm with her digital notepad and leans close with a soft, secretive smile.
data.animaCaption: Seated along the Seminar lounge sofa arm before a panoramic window sparkling with night city bokeh, she leans gently forward with a tablet in hand and a playful knowing smile wearing a translucent micro-pleated pure white double-chiffon slip dress.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white translucent double-layer pleated chiffon slip dress with ultra-thin spaghetti straps and a delicate micro-pleated bodice over bare shoulders and legs.
